Talk to IVN Media
01

What is PAO OS?

+

PAO OS is an AI business operating system developed by IVN Network. It aims to connect assistance, knowledge, plans, tasks and reports within a shared business context.

02

Who is PAO designed for?

+

PAO is designed around SMEs, startups, founders, CEOs, business owners and marketing teams who want a clearer way to organize work and collaborate with AI.

03

Is PAO just a chatbot?

+

Conversation is a starting point. PAO aims to connect business context with plans, specialist roles, review steps and work outcomes.

04

Can PAO work with different AI models?

+

PAO supports the selection of models and AI connections within its supported scope. Actual availability depends on configuration, providers and the business's data requirements.

05

How does PAO support marketing?

+

PAO helps connect briefs, goals, audiences, messages, content plans and performance context. Platform connections, publishing and advertising actions require agreed permissions and deployment scope.

06

Does PAO replace the team?

+

PAO is designed to support and coordinate work. People still define goals, supply context, review quality and decide on important actions.

07

How is business data handled?

+

PAO is designed around business-scoped context and permissions. Data sources, access scope and AI connections should be selected to meet each organization's security requirements.

08

How can I learn more about PAO?

+

Contact IVN Media at cs@pao-os.com or through the hotline to discuss your needs, product scope and a suitable way to explore PAO.
